design: Keep the per-row predictions frozen. Sample the 15 entire held-out exposure pairs with replacement. Cross that draw independently with draws of contiguous channel blocks (4 or 8 channels). Use one common set of draws for every model, band and percentile. Separately omit each pair. Targets are gain-minus-LIN0 differences of group medians and p95 absolute errors; resampling intervals are descriptive and conditional on the two observed sessions and fixed models.
